name: codex-realtime-voice
responsibility: The public MIT voice agent: one host entry for a server and one browser client, over Codex sessions, a coordinator, checkout workhorses and the host's own identity and policy
description: Its npm build bundles codex-app-server, process, timing and diagnostics, which are MIT like it; every other workspace package is BUSL and stays out of it. Archboard and the example reach it only through the entries an outside host uses.
